summary.name: Vozo
summary.one_liner: Vozo is an AI video localization tool that translates videos into 160+ languages with AI dubbing, lip sync, subtitles, and on-screen text translation.
use_cases: localizing marketing or campaign videos for new markets
dubbing vlogs, interviews, or dramas into other languages
localizing corporate training and onboarding videos
automating video translation through an API
summary.what_it_does: Vozo translates spoken audio in videos into 160+ languages and produces dubbed voiceovers, with an option to clone the original speaker's voice (VoiceREAL) or optimize delivery for a local market (VoiceNATIVE). Its lip sync feature matches each speaker's lip movements to the translated speech. It can generate translated subtitle files or embed subtitles directly into videos. Visual Translate detects, erases, and translates on-screen text such as overlays and slide text while preserving layout and style. The page also mentions an API for integrating these capabilities and enterprise features such as team workspaces and admin controls.
notable: Visual Translate erases and re-translates on-screen text, which the page says is unique to Vozo
Two dubbing modes: VoiceREAL keeps the original speaker's voice and VoiceNATIVE targets local clarity
Lip sync matches speaker mouth movements to translated speech
Page cites SOC 2 Type II and GDPR-aligned data handling for enterprise use
caveats: Page does not give specific prices; it mentions a free trial and sign-up only
Enterprise features such as admin controls and dedicated support are described without pricing details
Performance claims (30x faster, 90% lower costs) come from a single customer testimonial and are not independently verified
